name: WebhookX
author: SoftTent

sections.description:
WebhookX is a simple, yet powerful webhook plugin for WordPress. It’s easy to add webhook and extend according to your needs.

Additional Information

For more information and updates, visit the official website https://hellorakib.com.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL-2.0-or-later License.
sections.installation:
1. Upload webhookx to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Start using the plugin or develop it further as per your requirements.
sections.faq:
Where can I find documentation?

For detailed documentation, visit https://hellorakib.com.

Need Any Help?

  • Please mail us at contact@hellorakib.com
